game.name: Slipstream
game.desc: An arcade racer built on the look and feel of late 80s and early 90s racing games, with a synthpop and jazz fusion soundtrack. Drift through corners and draft behind rivals for a burst of speed across 20 tracks around the world. Play a Grand Tour with branching paths and rival races, a five-race Grand Prix with car upgrades, Cannonball runs with optional traffic, Battle Royale, single races and time trials, with five cars to choose from.
